findings.status: Semantic ambiguity requiring correction before treating the graph as executable logical evidence
findings.rule_statement: An incomplete RiskSignal response cannot become an accepted profile, and a missing reason code keeps the draft recoverable.

source_quote.text: An incomplete RiskSignal response cannot become an accepted profile. | A missing reason code keeps the draft recoverable.

source_logic: An incomplete response implies the profile cannot be accepted.
A missing reason code implies the draft remains recoverable.
findings.explanation: The source gives two condition-to-outcome implications. A single all group attaches both conditions to their combined rule without identifying which condition governs which outcome. If interpreted as a joint prerequisite, it can incorrectly require a missing reason code before applying the prohibition on accepting an incomplete response. The full rule text still preserves the source wording, so this finding concerns the graph's explicit logical structure rather than total textual loss.
findings.counterexample: An incomplete response with a reason code present must still be rejected according to the source. Treating both group members as necessary would fail to trigger that rejection.
findings.recommended_repair: Represent the separate implications with separately scoped outcomes or source-grounded atomic rules. Do not automatically replace all with any, which would also attach both outcomes to either condition. Preserve shared fact and source provenance when separating the implications.
